plainEnglish.summary: The presentation of blocks of text can be adjusted without losing content or functionality - inline margin, block margin, line length, line height and justification. The exact values are still to be determined in the draft. Hard-coded styling, such as raw text that is already capitalised or hyphenated, is exempt.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Readers with dyslexia, low vision or attention-related disabilities often need wider spacing or shorter lines. Layouts that break when those change force a choice between reading comfortably and reading at all.
